name: input.keyboard.type
description: Type a UTF-8 string into the focused window. Handles Unicode (including supplementary-plane chars) and avoids the quote-escape hazards of synthesising it as individual `input.keyboard.key` calls. Synthesised keystrokes deliver via the user32 layer only; targets that read the kernel keyboard table directly (DirectInput, RawInput, `GetAsyncKeyState`) — including Unity and most game frameworks — won't observe them. See `spec/operators/05-footguns.md` for the capability boundary.

text.description: UTF-8 text to type. Each codepoint is synthesised via `SendInput` with `KEYEVENTF_UNICODE` (skips the keyboard-layout translation step, so the character lands as-typed regardless of the user's keyboard layout). Empty string is valid and a no-op.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`. The focused window receives the text; no per-character status (errors are all-or-nothing at the synthesis level).

x-implementations.name: send_input_unicode
x-implementations.description: Win32 `SendInput` with INPUT_KEYBOARD events using `KEYEVENTF_UNICODE`. One down + up event pair per codepoint; supplementary-plane chars use surrogate-pair pairs. NT 5+. Bypasses keyboard-layout translation so non-ASCII chars land correctly regardless of the user's active layout.

x-implementations.name: set_clipboard_paste
x-implementations.description: Fallback for NT 4 / 9x where SendInput / KEYEVENTF_UNICODE is unavailable: sets clipboard to the text via OpenClipboard + SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT) and synthesises ctrl+V. Side effect: clipboard content overwritten — agent restores prior content after the paste.

windows-modern.description: SendInput with KEYEVENTF_UNICODE per codepoint. Reaches user32 message-queue listeners (most apps, including modern frameworks like WPF / WinUI / Electron). Does NOT reach RawInput / DirectInput — same limitation as input.keyboard.key (dist/PROTOCOL.md §4.4 / issue #64). UIPI applies.

windows-classic.description: SendInput KEYEVENTF_UNICODE on NT 5+. NT 4 / 9x agents fall back to clipboard-paste — set clipboard, ctrl+V, restore prior clipboard. The fallback is observable: brief clipboard contention is possible if another app reads the clipboard during the verb. Pre-NT-5 also lacks proper Unicode IME bridging in some apps; MBCS-converted ANSI fallback when KEYEVENTF_UNICODE produces no effect.
